messages:
Alex Liu: Hi all — first day questions. My corp laptop is delayed. Can I use my personal Linux laptop to finish onboarding this week? Also how/when do I complete privacy training and phishing sims? I set up SSO but SSH keys & HSM access are unclear.

onboard-bot: Welcome Alex! Please complete the 'privacy-bundle' and 'security-101' modules in the onboarding portal: https://redwood.co/onboarding. Enroll device via MDM when your corp device arrives. Ticket created: #INC-4823

Maya (People Ops): Welcome Alex :wave: You can use a personal laptop for up to 3 business days with conditions — must have full-disk encryption, OS/security updates applied, and a dedicated work user account. Please confirm you'll enable disk encryption and a screen lock. We'll tentatively schedule your security training for tomorrow 10:00 AM PT unless you prefer afternoon.

Samir (Security): Quick checklist for personal-device onboarding: 1) Full-disk encryption (FileVault on macOS, LUKS on Linux), 2) 2FA enabled + YubiKey when you get one (we ship them), 3) No local retention of customer data, 4) Enroll in phishsim within 48h.
Commands to verify encryption on Linux (example):
```
sudo cryptsetup status "$(ls /dev/mapper | grep crypt)" || sudo lsblk -o NAME,FSTYPE,SIZE,MOUNTPOINT | grep crypto
uname -r  # verify kernel version is supported
```
Send a screenshot of the disk encryption status and your OS version.

Jordana (Infra): For HSM/KMS and dev infra access we require either a corp-managed device or a cleared contractor VM. If you need immediate access we can provision a time-limited bastion VM with ephemeral keys — file an infra request at infra-requests@redwood.co and mention this thread. VPN + SSO are acceptable on a personal device only if MDM/Encryption proof is provided.

Dave (DevEx): SSH key note: create a new ed25519 keypair for work and upload it to the internal portal. Do NOT reuse personal deploy keys or push private keys to Git. If you only have one key, we can mint a short-lived work keypair for you. Docs: https://redwood.co/devex/ssh-keys :white_check_mark: 

Alex Liu: Thanks — I'll enable LUKS now and send the screenshot here. Also, will I be auto-enrolled in phishsim or do I need to sign up?

Samir (Security): We'll auto-enroll new hires, but you must opt in to the training tracker in the onboarding portal (link in the bot message). Expect the first simulated phish within ~72 hours. It's purely training: failures trigger automated coaching emails, not disciplinary action.

Maya (People Ops): Shipping: we can mail a YubiKey and a temporary hotspot if you need one for calls. I'll queue both today. Is the address on file still 1234 Redwood Ave? :package: :iphone: 

Alex Liu: Yes, that address is correct. One more small ask — my home Wi-Fi drops during video calls. Hotspot would be super helpful.

Maya (People Ops): Noted, hotspot added to the order. ETA 2-3 business days. If anything blocks you from completing the training tomorrow ping me in this thread and we'll reschedule.

Alex Liu: Awesome, thanks everyone :pray:
